text:
Priya: Posted the post-incident writeup for the 2025-03-14 serving disruption: https://redwood.internal/postmortem/2551113333 — TL;DR: inconsistent cache isolation + missing graceful-fallback test triggered elevated latency across a subset of hosts. Highlights + next steps below. Please respond with ack and update owners.

Jordan: Thanks — can we get a short customer-facing note draft? Need Product help.

Priya: Product (Jordan) will draft public-facing note, PM to own. Simon to own oncall verification. Alex to fix cache scoping. Tracy to own routing/fallback policy review.

Alex: Confirmed. I'll open the code change and link PR to the ticket. ETA code + tests: 2025-03-20.

Simon: I'll run the canary checks tomorrow morning and update the runbook if anything is off.

oncall-bot: Created followups ticket PM-2551113333 and scheduled checkpoint: 2025-03-18 15:00 PDT. Reminder set for 12h prior.

Priya: Action checklist (put into the doc as well):

```
- Fix: narrow cache key generation to be per-tenant + model variant; add unit tests. Owner: Alex. Due: 2025-03-20.
- CI: add simulated fallback test (synthetic traffic + KV-cache miss scenario). Owner: Priya. Due: 2025-03-18.
- Runbook: update rollback + verification steps, include traffic-check commands. Owner: Simon. Due: 2025-03-17.
- Policy: cross-region fallback thresholds review. Owner: Tracy. Due: 2025-03-23.
- Communications: customer note + internal summary for sales. Owner: Jordan (Product). Due: 2025-03-19.
```

Tracy: Re: cross-region thresholds — can infra-ops provide current metrics? tagging @infra-ops.

Priya: I'll ping infra-ops in a separate thread and attach current metric snapshots to the doc.

Jordan: Will draft the customer note; prefer 2-paragraph technical summary + remediation steps. Target to share for review by 2025-03-18.

Alex: added a small snippet to the issue with the proposed cache key change: `key = f"{tenant}:{model}:{deployment}:{seed}"` — will expand in PR.

Simon: Logging note — during incident we saw repeated 'cache-mismatch' logs from hosts a/b. I'll attach the logs to the followup ticket.

Priya: Quick ask — owners, please put status updates in the doc before the 3/18 checkpoint. We'll confirm closures and decide whether to push an update externally.

Jordan: ack.

Alex: ack.

Simon: ack, attaching logs now.

Tracy: acked.

Priya: Thanks all. Closing thread; checkpoint invite sent.
